title: Unveiling the Attribute Misbinding Threat in Identity-Preserving Models

bias_targets.methodology: Crafting adversarial prompts that exploit flawed attribute binding to misattribute sensitive or harmful traits to a primary human subject, measured via Prompt-Image Alignment and the Attribute Binding Safety Score (ABSS).

Evaluating the generation of discriminatory content against individuals as one of four specific risk dimensions (alongside pornography, violence, and illegality) using Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to score image safety.
